Name: Root Cellar Storage and Automation
Author: samreveries
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds a Root Cellar Terminal, Importer and Exporter to the Dwarf's shop. The player can choose between allowing the terminal to manage and access all of the chests on the farm, or optionally add virtual disk storage via a tab in the menu. Also adds tabs that act as trackers for perfection, recursive crafting using automatically priced big craftables, a geode cracker tab, a remote shop tab and more. All configurable via GMCM. This mod is a [i][b]full[/b][/i] rewrite of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26919]Ultimate Storage System[/url] by holybananapants with logic changes for performance and functionality built on top of this rewrite.[/color][/size] It was built mostly because my wife and I started a multiplayer world, and they were somehow worse than I am at inventory management.[/center]

[center]As this mod can be utilised to store [b]all[/b] of your items in non-standard storage, please be sure to backup your saves as a precaution![/center]

[line]

[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip and drop both folders in /Mods/. [/color][/size][/center]

[line]

[center][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Everything below lives in one terminal.[/color][/size]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8]Storage Tab[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Buy the Root Cellar Terminal from the Dwarf and view, search, and sort every chest on the farm. Items are grouped by category with live counts, a "where is this?" panel shows which chest/disk holds an item, you can pin favourites to the top of a category, and Smart Stash stores your inventory into matching storage.[/color][/size]
[url=https://postimg.cc/9w4dsdx1][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Y0RdG8Qc/image.png[/img][/url]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8]Virtual disk storage[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install storage Disks (Steel, Gold, Iridium tiers) for a high-capacity virtual archive, managed from the Disk tab. Tag each disk with a filter and deposited items sort themselves, use disks on their own, or combined with your physical chests.[/color][/size]
[url=https://postimg.cc/pmMf1nK5][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Z5Cwn8RH/image.png[/img][/url]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8]Filter builder[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Build filters with an editor. Match by category, item, name, context tag, quality, sell value, or other filters with a live "matches xyz items" preview. Filters disk sorting, importers/exporters, and routing.[/color][/size]
[url=https://postimg.cc/yWwckSQv][img]https://i.postimg.cc/kX5cYQx3/image.png[/img][/url]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8]Import/Export buses[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Place Importer and Exporter big craftables next to chests, machines, or the shipping bin. Exporters feed filtered items from storage into machines and bins; Importers pull from adjacent sources into the best-matching storage. Associate each with batch size, target stock, reserve amounts, random selection, and timed intervals.
[color=#ff0000]Performance note: Unfiltered importers WILL cause lag in large saves. I have taken significant effort to reduce lag with automation, however some has remained. This is roughly 11ms on extensive filters with many disks/chests in multiplayer.[/color][/color][/size]
[url=https://postimg.cc/7f8Jxrbv][img]https://i.postimg.cc/5NjBSxVt/image.png[/img][/url]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8] Recursive crafting & cooking[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Craft and cook straight from storage. The terminal works out how many of each recipe you can make through the entire crafting tree. Big craftables are priced automatically, and allow for machine-based autocrafting. This is one of the cheatier aspects of the mod, and the upgrades tab can be disabled via GMCM. [/color][/size]
[url=https://postimg.cc/cKHrDskd][img]https://i.postimg.cc/fb7mRyxS/image.png[/img][/url]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8] Geode cracker[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Crack geodes directly from storage without a trip to Clint. My wife doesn't like Clint. That's why this tab exists.
[color=#ff0000]Performance note: cracking upwards of 1000 geodes at once can cause a ~100-200ms hang, increasing with count.[/color][/color][/size]
[url=https://postimg.cc/WqM3Dtzx][img]https://i.postimg.cc/j21JF7bq/image.png[/img][/url][url=https://postimages.org/]message board image codes[/url]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8] Shops [/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Opens shops. My wife didn't like having to wait, and I didn't know [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20985]Self-Serve[/url] was an option. This is another of the cheatier features.[/color][/size]
[color=#ff0000]Does not currently support all in-game shops.[/color]
[url=https://postimg.cc/KR2j67s1][img]https://i.postimg.cc/vH1n63rt/image.png[/img][/url]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8]Perfection tracker[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A tab that tracks your progress toward Perfection. You can craft, cook, and ship from this menu to complete perfection, and these will update perfection tracking.[/color][/size]
[url=https://postimg.cc/5H62Bsj7][img]https://i.postimg.cc/XvgB0hWb/image.png[/img][/url]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8]Routing, cleanup & activity log[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]See routing priority and conflict warnings, compact duplicate stacks, move items between physical and disk storage, and review a running log of everything stored, withdrawn, moved, and automated.
[color=#ff0000]Performance note: Compact all will reduce large save lag a whole lot, but also can cause extensive hangs on run.[/color][/color][/size]
[url=https://postimg.cc/zLs8n5sX][img]https://i.postimg.cc/9MM0HQ1T/image.png[/img][/url]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8]Multiplayer[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Mostly multiplayer-aware. Disk storage is host-authoritative and protected against item duplication or loss and counts update live as other players add or remove items. Everything should be optimistic and I've tested under extreme network conditions locally. You [b]shouldn't[/b] be able to lose or duplicate items.
[size=1][color=#660000]no promises i can't test everyone's game[/color][/size][/color][/size]

[size=3][b][color=#D4D4D8]Configurable[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Hide any tabs you don't use and adjust terminal shop prices, disk prices, and the machine-link material multiplier through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/color][/size]
[/center]

[line]

[center][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Tagframework is bundled but optional. Adds functionality for filtering e.g. adds context tags for seasonality to seeds that did not previously have it.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] is required for the assets. [/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] is a must with import/export automation, as there is [b]intentionally[/b] no integration with machine groups. Use a chest as an intermediary to enter machine groups with importers/exporters[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] for configuration is optional.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][size=4][b]Stats for Nerds[/b][/size][/center]
[center][spoiler]
I took every chance to test the mod. It has now been tested across two in-game years, and any update to the mod [b]will[/b] be backwards compatible. Even if you somehow have an old version of the disks, the mod should migrate them automatically. The main reason for this is simple: this mod is primarily used by me and my wife on our own save.

On a test save with these clumsy settings, items can take a lot of [i]time[/i] to feed through, but nothing is duplicated or lost.
[url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/28Jp88w2/image.png[/img][/url]

This is because storage is host-authoritative. Cache rebuilding, automation, and related work are handled by the host machine, so in multiplayer I recommend having the strongest machine host the game. For maximum lag reduction, a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2677]Always On Server[/url] or similar may help, with the trade-off that all players will experience server latency rather than just clients.

Despite my test suite returning 0 failures, there will almost certainly still be bugs, and some intentional features may look like bugs at first glance. Due to the nature of the mod, item loss or duplication is technically possible. If either happens, please submit a bug report with as much detail as possible.

The mod has only been tested in real multiplayer with my wife about five feet away from me. I can emulate network conditions locally, but I cannot fully predict every real-world network environment. Safety was my biggest concern, with performance a close second, but as with all mods, there may still be gaps.

Automation is another major performance strain and has been iterated on extensively. There are many measures in place to reduce automation lag, but it [b]will[/b] affect performance. You may notice a hang when a new automation bus runs and builds indexes; this is a one-time trade-off to reduce lag during the rest of the play session.

If you've read this part, feel free to @.eucalyptus. on the SDV discord with any questions that are quicker than a bug report.[/spoiler]
[/center]

[line]

[center][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]I haven't run into any compatibility issues thus far, however I'll add any known compatibility issues into this section!

[/size]
[left]
[*][size=3] Monster Hutch Framework does not work with Argon.TagFramework (bundled for filters) - looking into a fix but for time being, remove Argon.TagFramework. RC will work without it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Mobile does not work. Might fix.[/size]
[/*]
[/left]
[size=3]One thing to note, though, is extensively modded saves with many things happening on UpdateTicked or TimeChanged may cause increases in lag with heavy RC automation.[/size]
[/center]

Manifest.Name: Argon Tag Framework
Manifest.Description: Derives item metadata from game data (crops, seeds, fruit trees, animals, fish, machines, recipes, gift tastes) and exposes it as namespaced context tags
Manifest.Author: reveries

Manifest.Name: RootCellar
Manifest.Description: A farm terminal for managing chests and a virtual disk archive, with crafting and cooking from storage, automation importers/exporters, shipping and geode tools, and a visual filter builder. Originally inspired by Ultimate Storage System by holybananapants.
Manifest.Author: reveries

Manifest.Name: RootCellarContentPack
Manifest.Description: Content Patcher assets for RootCellar: the Root Cellar terminal, importer/exporter big craftables, and Dwarf shop entries.
Manifest.Author: reveries
